name: Youchul Jeong
title: Ph.D. Candidate in Marine Science
about: Youchul Jeong is a Ph.D. candidate in Marine Science at the University of the Aegean and a member of the Marine Remote Sensing Group (MRSG). He is also an External Ph.D. candidate with the Machine Learning in Earth Observation (MEO) Lab at the University of Bonn. His research focuses on detecting floating marine debris using satellite and UAV imagery, remote sensing, and machine learning.

experience.description: Led the design and field deployment of 18–90 m² floating plastic-litter targets in the Gulf of Gera, Lesvos. Led satellite and drone imagery processing and analysis to assess floating plastic detection across multiple spatial and spectral scales.

Constructed floating plastic-litter targets using HDPE tarps and wooden planks in 1 m², 2 m², and 3 m² configurations for the PLP2025 field experiment. Assisted with field deployment, monitoring, repair, and retrieval of six target units in the Gulf of Gera, Lesvos.

experience.position: Drone Analysis of Beach Safety and Beachgoer Behavior
experience.description: Orchestrated drone flights and implemented YOLOv8 to observe beach safety. Conducted surveys of beachgoer populations to understand motivations and improve beach conditions.

experience.position: Classification and Monitoring of Floating Marine Macro Litter (MSc Thesis)
experience.description: Utilized drones with multispectral sensors to create a custom FMML dataset. Implemented deep learning models for efficient litter classification and continuous monitoring. Incorporated drone atmospheric correction using DROACOR in collaboration with Dr. Daniel Schläpfer (ReSe Application LLC). Worked with advisors to promote conceptual framework and fieldwork at international conferences.

experience.position: Floating Marine Debris and Physical Ocean Phenomena in S-ORS
experience.description: Applied drone technology and Applied Drone Automatic Flight Advisory in open ocean conditions. Developed a CNN model for detecting marine debris for Socheongcho Ocean Research Station.

experience.position: Drone Survey of Spotted Seal Population
experience.description: Conducted drone surveys on Baekryeong Island to assess spotted seal populations and gather high-resolution imagery.

experience.institution: Korea Institute of Ocean Science & Technology (KIOST)
experience.description: Worked with Dr. Won Joon Shim (KIOST) to conduct on-site surveys of microplastics and floating marine litter. Compared and analyzed results of drone and multispectral sensor surveys.
Conducted RTK-GPS and drone surveys to analyze coastal sand loss and seabed depth change.
Assembled military training UAVs, managed GPS element procurement, and led team activities.
